## Course Overview

The course introduces practical and theoretical foundations of data science, including data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, machine learning methods, model evaluation, and project-based problem solving.

## Communication and Updates

Please check the [Announcements](announcements/) section regularly for important updates on deadlines, classes, office hours, and materials.
